attention_review.continuity_observed: Same worn chart, OpenEvidence unit and Answer card (Sources filled, Accuracy dashed) carry across the cuts at about 5.3 s (s1 to s2), 12.0 s (to s3), 16.8 s (to s4), 22.0 s (to s5), 29.4 s (to s6), 33.4 s (to s7) and 39.0 s (to s8). In s5 a wall of 12 clinician badges is new, and the tool and date tag remain visible below it.
attention_review.pacing_observed: Timed developments: 0.4 to 1.2 s question into tool; 3.2 to 4.8 s answer slides out and three citation cards tuck in; 5.8 to 6.8 s Announced tag pins; 10.4 to 11.0 s Live since March tag pins; 12.2 to 14.0 s credentials typed and lock opens; 15.0 to 16.3 s question typed; 17.2 to 18.6 s three cited cards fan out; 22.2 to 24.0 s badges light and slider passes Half; 25.2 to 25.6 s tag pins; 27.6 to 28.4 s own-report tag; 30.2 to 32.0 s two tags and Not in release; 34.0 to 35.0 s thread from literature card to Sources; 36.8 s push-in; 37.2 to 38.4 s Accuracy ring pulses; 39.4 to 40.2 s evaluating tag; 41.6 to 42.6 s cut and ring pulse. Unearned slow stretches: 6.8 to 10.0 s and 18.6 to 21.8 s. Nothing arrives too fast.
attention_review.comprehension_observed: Viewer gets the subject, the dated announcement, the mechanism (typed question, answer plus citations), usage claim and the limit. Minor overload risk in s2 with two date tags in 6.7 s and in s5 with many badges. Not a conclusive case example. Illustration disclosure is always visible.
attention_review.remembered_image: The Answer card with filled Sources slot beside a dashed empty Accuracy ring, pulsing at 37.2 to 38.4 s, with a thread leading to the Medical literature card. It carries the central claim and the source limit.
attention_review.weakest_interval: 6.8 to 10.0 s in s2: the Announced tag has pinned and only an underline animates for about 3 s while the hands freeze. Repair: retime the tag pin to about 8.6 s and add a docking slide or glow sweep at the record edge between 6.8 and 8.4 s.
attention_review.audio_basis: No direct listening and no MP4 playback. I used the provider audio receipt (gemini-3.8-flash, audio_access true, 'not human listening'), mix.json measurements, captions.json cue times and the caption text visible in frames. Waveform and loudness numbers can't establish a natural performance.

first_frame.observed: Typing hands, a Question card filling in, padlock and chart, then the card travels toward the tool by 1.0 to 1.2 s. Readable and moving immediately.

visual_progression.observed: Each scene adds a new pictured step (answer with sources, date tags, credentials, citations, badge wall, tags, thread, evaluation tag) and carries completed results forward. Some holds 6.8 to 10.0 s and 18.6 to 21.8 s are thin.

shot_variety.observed: Desk and keyboard top-down, tool close-up, wide chart, badge board, tag close-ups, citation stack on paper, push-in on the Answer card. Variety is genuine, though all cuts are the same flat-dimensional illustration family.
